correctness.rationale: All quantifiers and normalizations checked: Catalan incidence vectors correspond bijectively to vertices; reflection and first-return decompositions derive the complete step-bias vector; the stated bivariate PDE and coefficient extraction recover the central-binomial ratio. Summation of Bernoulli coordinate variances proves the exact finite-size formula. The elliptic singular expansion with modulus sqrt(z) yields the sharp logarithmic and constant terms, with coefficient remainders. Standalone integer/rational exhaustive checker passed n=1..7, including pairwise distances. Finite checks alone are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The result computes a natural Euclidean mean-squared-distance invariant for every Catalan matroid polytope and proves a sharp logarithmic separation from the containing hypersimplex despite both vertex sets having exactly n ones. The O(log n) deficit and explicit 2/pi coefficient reflect the global Dyck nonnegativity constraint and are useful as reference data for metric geometry and random-base sampling, rather than a mere local numerical improvement.
